CHAR_SCROOGE.description: Elderly tight-fisted London businessman; pointed nose; shrivelled cheek; thin blue lips; red-rimmed eyes; stiff gait; frosty rime on head, brows, and wiry chin; grating voice; solitary as an oyster.
CHAR_SCROOGE.display_name_policy: On first picture card: Ebenezer Scrooge; thereafter Scrooge.

voice_profile.dialect_notes: Victorian London gentleman, cold and caustic

age_variants.label: prime of life, growing avarice

CHAR_SCROOGE.source_evidence: Hard and sharp as flint, from which no steel had ever struck out generous fire; secret, and self-contained, and solitary as an oyster.

CHAR_MARLEY.description: Ghost of Scrooge’s partner; same face as in life; pigtail; waistcoat, tights, boots; transparent body; chain of cash-boxes, keys, padlocks, ledgers, deeds, steel purses; kerchief bound about head and chin; death-cold eyes.

voice_profile.dialect_notes: same class as Scrooge; cries of remorse

visual_lock.hair: pigtail; hair stirred as by hot air

wardrobe_variants.label: ghostly office dress and forged chain
wardrobe_variants.source_evidence: The chain he drew was clasped about his middle... cash-boxes, keys, padlocks, ledgers, deeds, and heavy purses wrought in steel.

CHAR_MARLEY.source_evidence: In life I was your partner, Jacob Marley.

CHAR_NEPHEW.description: Scrooge’s cheerful nephew; ruddy handsome face; sparkling eyes; breath smoking from rapid walking in fog and frost; all in a glow.

age_variants.label: married young man
age_variants.source_evidence: He had so heated himself with rapid walking in the fog and frost, this nephew of Scrooge's, that he was all in a glow; his face was ruddy and handsome; his eyes sparkled

wardrobe_variants.label: Christmas Eve outdoor street clothes
wardrobe_variants.source_evidence: rapid walking in the fog and frost

CHAR_NEPHEW.source_evidence: A merry Christmas, uncle! God save you!" cried a cheerful voice. It was the voice of Scrooge's nephew

wardrobe_variants.source_evidence: in came little Bob, the father, with at least three feet of comforter exclusive of the fringe, hanging down before him; and his threadbare clothes darned up and brushed, to look seasonable

CHAR_CRATCHIT.source_evidence: the clerk, who in a dismal little cell beyond, a sort of tank, was copying letters.

CHAR_TINY_TIM.description: Cratchit’s small crippled boy; little crutch; limbs supported by iron frame; thoughtful; plaintive gentle presence.

age_variants.label: living child

CHAR_TINY_TIM.source_evidence: God bless us every one!" said Tiny Tim, the last of all.

CHAR_MRS_CRATCHIT.description: Bob’s wife; dressed poorly in a twice-turned gown but brave in ribbons; proud cook of the pudding; fierce in defense of family against Scrooge.

age_variants.label: mother

voice_profile.dialect_notes: soft and gentle; singularly low as if at a distance

visual_lock.hair: white, hanging about neck and back
visual_lock.distinguishing_marks: bright jet of light from crown; fluctuating limbs

age_variants.label: supernatural visitor

wardrobe_variants.label: white tunic, flowers, holly, extinguisher cap
wardrobe_variants.source_evidence: It wore a tunic of the purest white; and round its waist was bound a lustrous belt

CHAR_GHOST_PAST.source_evidence: I am the Ghost of Christmas Past.

CHAR_GHOST_PRESENT.description: Jolly Giant; green robe bordered with white fur; bare breast and feet; holly wreath with icicles; long dark brown free curls; glowing torch like Plenty’s horn; empty rusted scabbard; genial sparkling eye.

visual_lock.distinguishing_marks: holly wreath with icicles; bare breast; torch

age_variants.label: glorious giant
age_variants.years: very young spirit of the year
age_variants.source_evidence: there sat a jolly Giant, glorious to see

age_variants.label: near midnight, hair grey
age_variants.source_evidence: looking at the Spirit as they stood together in an open place, he noticed that its hair was grey.

wardrobe_variants.label: green fur-bordered mantle and holly crown
wardrobe_variants.source_evidence: It was clothed in one simple green robe, or mantle, bordered with white fur.

CHAR_GHOST_PRESENT.source_evidence: I am the Ghost of Christmas Present," said the Spirit. "Look upon me!"

CHAR_GHOST_FUTURE.description: Solemn Phantom draped and hooded in deep black; face and form concealed; only one outstretched hand visible; tall, stately, silent; scatters gloom.
CHAR_GHOST_FUTURE.display_name_policy: Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come

voice_profile.dialect_notes: communicates only by pointing hand and hood motion

visual_lock.distinguishing_marks: single outstretched hand from black shroud

age_variants.label: shrouded spectre
age_variants.source_evidence: It was shrouded in a deep black garment, which concealed its head, its face, its form, and left nothing of it visible save one outstretched hand.

wardrobe_variants.label: deep black hooded garment
wardrobe_variants.source_evidence: a solemn Phantom, draped and hooded, coming, like a mist along the ground

CHAR_GHOST_FUTURE.source_evidence: I am in the presence of the Ghost of Christmas Yet To Come?" said Scrooge.
